Wel mosharka ma3 group bete3mel nafs el haga le kol el a3daa marra wahda. We law deeft had lel group ba3dein hayshoof el menus elli etsharket ma3aha, fa mesh hate3eed el da3wa kol ma el team yetghayyar.

sections.heading: El adwar we ergaa3 el wosool
paragraphs: Kol mosharka shayla dor. El mosahem beydeef ekhtiyarato, wel muharrer kaman yeader yeghayyar el menu nafsaha, wel moshahed beyboss men gheir ma yetlob. Wel melkeya 3omraha ma betentaqel bel mosharka.
Tedar teghayyar dor ay had aw teshilo men safhet "El a3daa" fe ay wa2t. We shail el wosool mabyemsahsh elli sahamo beh fe order khalas, fa el fawatir el adima tefdal mazbota.

faq.question: Elli bad3eeh lazem yekoon 3ando hesab?
faq.answer: Aywa. Kol mosharka betetfateh ba3d tasgeel el dokhool, fa el da3wa betekmel be hesab haqiqi. We elli maandoosh hesab beyetwaggah lel tasgeel we yerga3 lel da3wa.

faq.question: Eh elli yehsal law alghet share link?
faq.answer: Yewaaf 3ala tool le ay had lessa mesta3melosh. Wel nas elli dakhalo khalas beyefdalo lehad ma teshilhom men safhet el a3daa.

faq.question: A2dar asharek nafs el menu ma3 kaza group?
faq.answer: Aywa. El menu momken tetsharek ma3 ay 3adad as7ab we groups, we kol mosharka shayla dorha.

run-an-order-round.seoTitle: Ezay tedeer order round lel group | Gama3 Orderak
run-an-order-round.description: Eftah round men menu metsharek, egma3 ekhtiyarat el kol, tabe3 elli ma raddesh, gammed el order, we eb3ato be egmali mawthooq.
run-an-order-round.heading: Ezay tedeer order round lel group
run-an-order-round.introduction: El round heya marra wahda men el talab men menu: ghada el naharda, aw tawseel el leila di. El menu betefdal makanha wel rounds betigi we temshi. El dalil da beyghatti ezay teftah round, tegma3 el ekhtiyarat men gheir ma tegri wara el nas fel chat, we te2felha 3ashan el egmali yewaaf 3an el harka.

sections.heading: Eftah el round
paragraphs: Men menu metsharek ekhtar "Ebda round". Kol elli sharekt ma3ahom el menu beyetdafo lel round otomatiki we beyoosalhom esh3ar, fa mafish da3wa tanya teb3atha.
El round betakhod asnaf el menu wel as3ar we siyaset el rosoom zay ma heya fel lahza di. Wel ta3dilat elli teegi ba3dein 3ala el menu maberga3sh le round shaghala.

sections.heading: Egma3 el ekhtiyarat
paragraphs: Kol wahed beyeftah el round we yehot el kammeyat odam elli 3ayzo. We beyshoof egmalio bel nesba leh shamel nasibo men el rosoom, fa mahadesh yehtag yes2al howa 3aleh kam.
We enta ka monazzem beteshoof meen radd we meen la. We di el gozaa elli 3adatan beyakhod aktar wa2t fel chat: el egaba 3ala screen wahda mesh mabathoota bein meet resala.
El nas te2dar teghayyar ekhtiyaratha tool ma el round maftooha. We kol taghyeer beyeaddel el egmali fe nafs el lahza, fa el rakam elli enta shayfo dayman gedid mesh rakam hasabto men 3ashar da2ayeq.

sections.heading: Gammed we eb3at el order
paragraphs: Lamma el kol yeredd, gammed el round. El tagmeed beywaaf el taghyeer we yethabbet el as3ar, fa el egmali mayetharaksh wenta 3ala el telefon ma3 el mat3am.
Wel 3ard el megammad beyegma3 el asnaf el motashabha ma3 ba3d, we da elli bete2rah fe3lan wenta bettelob: tamanya men nafs el sandwich mesh tamanya sotoor lewahdohom.

sections.heading: El taswiya
paragraphs: Ba3d ma el order yeb3at, nasib kol wahed yeb2a mahsoob khalas, shamel el dariba wel khedma we gozo men el tawseel hasab el siyasa elli 3ala el menu.
Wel fawatir betefdal mawgooda ba3d ma el round te2fel, fa so2al ba3d osboo3 yeb2a leeh egaba mesh me3tamda 3ala zakerat had.

faq.question: Law had khales maraddesh?
faq.answer: Tedar tegammed el round men gheiro. Mesh haykoon gozaa men el egmali, wel nas elli raddo mesh hayet3attalo 3ashan wahed.

faq.question: A2dar aftah round megammada tani?
faq.answer: Aywa, tool ma makhalsetsh. Fat-h tani beyesma7 bel taghyeer we beye3eed hesab el egmali, amma el round el khalsana fatefdal zay ma heya 3ashan el fawatir el adima tefdal mazbota.

faq.question: El kol beyshoof el nas talabet eh?
faq.answer: El moshtarkeen beyshofo el order el megamma3 3ashan el group yerag3o abl ma yeb3at. Amma el egmali el shakhsi fabyefdal marboot be sahbo.

invite-friends.seoTitle: Ezay tedeef as7ab we tesharek link el da3wa | Gama3 Orderak
invite-friends.description: Tare2ten 3ashan tebni list as7abak: dawwar 3ala had bel email betaa3o bel zabt, aw sharek link da3wa 24 sa3a yekhalli ay had yedeefak men gheir ma tewafe2 3ala kol talab.
invite-friends.heading: Ezay tedeef as7ab
invite-friends.introduction: List el as7ab bettewaffar tekrar el da3awat. Awel ma had yeb2a feeha tedar tesharek menu ma3ah 3ala tool, aw tedeefo le group, aw tebda round shamlah men gheir ma teb3at haga yesta3melha. Fi tare2ten 3ashan tebniha we kol wahda tenfa3 fe halа mokhtalfa.

sections.heading: Dawwar 3ala had bel email
paragraphs: Eftah "El a3daa" ba3dein "El as7ab" we dawwar bel 3onwan elli el shakhs sagel beh bel zabt. Mahadesh madroog 3alanan wel motabaqat el goz2eya matergaash haga, fa el 3onwan howa el tare2a el wahida 3ashan telaqi had hena.
We da maqsood. El dalil elli yenfa3 tedawwar feeh yekhalli ay had yegma3 list be mostakhdemeen el app, amma eshterat el 3onwan kamel ya3ni enak matelaqish gheir elli edak 3onwano khalas.

sections.heading: Sharek link el da3wa
paragraphs: Link el sadaka asra3 lamma teb2a bted3i kaza wahed marra wahda. E3melo men safhet "El as7ab" we eb3ato fe ay makan bettetkallem feeh khalas: resala, group chat, ay haga.

Ay had yeftaho khilal 24 sa3a yeader yedeefak be daghta wahda. Enta mabtewafe2sh 3ala kol wahed: mosharket el link heya mowafqetak, we da bel zabt el hadaf meno. We nafs el link yeshtaghal le ay 3adad nas yeftahoh.
We law tefaddal tewafe2 3ala kol wahed, esta3mel el bahs bel email we khalihom yeb3atolak talab. El tare2ten byentahi le nafs el makan, wel far2 bas fe meen elli yeaked.

sections.heading: El talabat we elli yehsal ba3dein
paragraphs: El talab el mab3oot bel bahs bel email beyestanna fe safhet "El talabat" lehad ma el tarf el tani yeredd. Wel qabool beyekhalli el sadaka motabadla 3ala tool, fa kol wahed yebaan fe list el tani men gheir ma had ye3eed el khatwa.
Wel esh3arat betaollak lamma talab yewsal aw yetabel, fa mateb2ash mestanni we mesh 3aref wesel walla la.

sections.heading: Shail sahb
paragraphs: El shail fawri we beyshilko men list ba3d. Bas mabyemsahsh el tarikh el moshtarak: el menu elli kontu feeha sawa, we ay round sahamt feeha, byefdalo zay ma homma bel zabt.
We shail el sahb mabyelghish wosoolo lel menus elli sharekthom ma3ah abl keda. Elghi da lewahdo men safhet "El a3daa" fel menu law da elli enta asdo.

faq.question: Leh mesh adar adawwar 3ala el nas bel esm?
faq.answer: 3ashan el bahs bel esm haykhalli el app dalil be mostakhdemeeno. El bahs bel email kamel ya3ni enak matelaqish gheir elli sharek 3onwano ma3ak khalas.

faq.question: Amen enni anshor link el da3wa 3alanan?
faq.answer: E3tebero shebh khass. Ay had yeftaho khilal 24 sa3a yeader yedeefak, fa eb3ato fel makan elli hatertah feeh en kol elli mawgood yedeefak.

faq.question: A2dar awaqqaf link el da3wa badri?
faq.answer: Aywa. El elghaa beywaafo 3ala tool. Amma elli esta3melo khalas fabyefdal fe list as7abak lehad ma teshilo.

work-with-groups.seoTitle: Ezay testakhdem el groups lel talabat el motekarrera | Gama3 Orderak
work-with-groups.description: E3mel group marra wahda, sharek el menus ma3 kol elli feeha fe nafs el wa2t, we deef aw sheel nas men gheir ma te3eed el da3awat. Ma3 links da3wet el group wel adwar.
work-with-groups.heading: Ezay testakhdem el groups lel talabat el motekarrera
work-with-groups.introduction: El group heya magmo3et nas leeha esm we betetlob ma3ahom bel marra: team, aw dor, aw 3ela. We mosharket menu ma3 el group betsharkha ma3 kol elli feeha, we elli yetdaf ba3dein beywrath elli etsharek khalas. El dalil da beyghatti ezay te3melha we temlaha we tekhalliha metrattaba.

sections.heading: E3mel el group
paragraphs: Eftah "El a3daa" ba3dein "Groups el as7ab" we e3mel group be esm el nas hate3rafo zay "Team el design" aw "El dor el talet". Wel wasf el oshayar beyesa3ed lamma had yekoon fe kaza group.
Enta betemlek el group elli bete3melha. Enta bas elli te2dar teghayyar esmha aw ted3i feeha aw teshil nas aw temsahha, wel melkeya di 3omraha ma betentaqel bel mosharka.

sections.heading: Deef nas
paragraphs: Ed3i as7abak lel group men card el group. Ay had fe list as7abak momken yetdaf 3ala tool, we da el tare2 el 3aady le team betetlob ma3ah kol osboo3.

Amma el nas elli lessa mesh fe list as7abak, e3mel link da3wa lel group we eb3ato. Wel had elli yeftaho khilal 24 sa3a beyedkhol el group 3ala tool, men gheir friend request el awel we men gheir mowafqa mennak 3ala kol wahed.
Wel link da asra3 tare2a temla group gedida. E3melo marra, elzako fe chat el team, we kol elli 3ayez yedkhol yedkhol, men gheir ma tetsarraf fe tabor talabat.

sections.heading: Sharek el menus ma3 el group
paragraphs: Sharek menu ma3 el group we kol elli feeha yeader yesta3melha 3ala tool. We di el gozaa elli bewaffar aktar tekrar: fe3l wahed badal da3wa le kol wahed.
Wel had elli yetdaf lel group ba3d keda beyshoof el menus elli etsharket ma3aha khalas. Fa zamil gedid yedkhol fe maris mesh me7tag te3eed da3awat yanayer.

sections.heading: Khalliha mahdatha
paragraphs: Sheel had men el group we wosoolo 3an tareeq-ha byentahi. Amma el wosool elli eddetoh leeh lewahdo — menu sharkthaha ma3ah 3ala tool — fa da monfasel we beyefdal lehad ma telghih howa kaman.
Wel a3daa yeadro yesibo el group be nafsohom. We mas7 el group beyshilha men 3and el kol, bas mabyemsahsh el menus elli etsharket 3an tareeq-ha wala ay round khalsana.

faq.question: A2dar adawwar 3ala group we adkholoha?
faq.answer: Mesh bel esm. El dokhool lel groups be link da3wa men el malek, fa mahadesh yelaqi group we yedkhol feeha we el malek ma da3ahoosh.

faq.question: Kol elli fel group beyshofo ba3d?
faq.answer: El a3daa beyshofo meen fel group, we da elli beyekhalliha group. Bas mabyeb2oosh as7ab otomatiki, wel emailat betaathom mabtebansh be mogarrad el 3odweya.

faq.question: El menu el metsharek yehsallo eh law masahet el group?
faq.answer: El menu nafsaha mabtetaathersh, heya melk elli 3amalha. Amma el wosool elli etadda 3an tareeq el group fa byentahi, fa sharekha tani 3ala tool aw 3an tareeq group tanya law el nas lessa me7tagaha.
